errorCodes.meaning: The caller holds no registration for this event. Nothing changed.

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

EventInstant.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, such as `2026-11-30T18:30:00Z`.
EventInstant.title: EventInstant

EventLifecycle.description: `draft`: seen only by its hosts, changes freely, takes no registrations. `published`: seen by its audience, takes registrations; its roster setting is fixed. `cancelled`: will not happen; kept so registrants and their agents see it was cancelled, and takes no registrations. Whether a published event has ended is read from its time, never stored (VTI-EVT-004).
EventLifecycle.title: EventLifecycle

EventRef.description: What a receipt says of the event a registration belongs to: enough for the registrant's agent to show it as it was when the community answered (VTI-EVT-092).

placeSummary.description: The event's coarse place hint, never an address (VTI-EVT-062). Absent where the event has none.

suggestedReminderMinutes.description: The reminders the event's hosts suggest, as minutes before its start, so the registrant's agent can fire them without reading the event again (VTI-CAL-041). Absent where the hosts suggest none.

EventRef.title: EventRef

EventTitle.description: A short name. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
EventTitle.title: EventTitle

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

JSCalendarDuration.description: A non-negative duration in the subset of ISO 8601 JSCalendar uses: `P` then weeks or days, then `T` with hours, minutes and seconds, such as `PT1H30M`, `P1D` or `P2W`. No months or years. Used only for `When.duration`, which carries JSCalendar's own member and encoding verbatim; this family's own offsets are integers naming their unit (`ReminderMinutes`).
JSCalendarDuration.title: JSCalendarDuration

LocalDateTime.description: A local date and time with no offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, as JSCalendar's LocalDateTime. Read in the event's `timeZone`.
LocalDateTime.title: LocalDateTime

anyOf.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation whose `nonce` is the request's `id` and whose `domain` is the community's DID, both signed by its holder's Data Integrity proof.
A compact presentation: an SD-JWT with a key-binding JWT whose `nonce` is the request's `id` and whose `aud` is the community's DID.

MembershipPresentation.description: A partner member's presentation of the membership credential a partner the event's audience names issued them, made by the credential's subject — who signs the request — and bound to it: its `nonce` the request's `id`, its `domain` this community's DID (VTI-EVT-132). The community verifies it before, and without reference to, the event, and discards it once it has decided (VTI-EVT-133).
MembershipPresentation.title: MembershipPresentation

PlaceSummary.description: A coarse hint shown with the event to its whole audience — `Central London`, `Online` — never the address. Plain text.
PlaceSummary.title: PlaceSummary

Registration.description: One registrant's registration for one event. The registrant reads all of it; a host reads all of it; another registrant on a `visible` roster reads only `entryId`, `status` and `guests` (VTI-EVT-053). Exactly one of `entryId` (a member) and `registrantDid` (a partner's member, VTI-EVT-134) names the registrant.

answers.description: The registrant's and the hosts' view only.

codeOfConductAcknowledged.description: The `sha256` of the code of conduct the registrant acknowledged.

entryId.description: The registrant's directory entry, where they are a member. Exactly one of `entryId` and `registrantDid` is present.

eventSequence.description: The event's `sequence` when the registration last changed, so a registrant sees whether the event changed since.

note.description: A host's note on a decline or removal, shown to the registrant. Plain text.

registrantDid.description: A registrant who is not a member of the community — a partner's member (VTI-EVT-134) — by the DID they presented as. Shown to the event's hosts and to the registrant only.

roster.description: The roster setting the registration was made under (VTI-EVT-052).

waitlistPosition.description: While `waitlisted`: the registrant's place in the queue, 1 first.

Registration.title: Registration

RegistrationAnswer.description: An answer to a question: a string for `text` and `choice`, a boolean for `boolean`.
RegistrationAnswer.title: RegistrationAnswer

RegistrationId.description: Opaque identifier of one registrant's registration for one event: `reg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community; a registrant has at most one registration per event (VTI-EVT-030).
RegistrationId.title: RegistrationId

RegistrationQuestionId.description: A question's key within its event.
RegistrationQuestionId.title: RegistrationQuestionId

RegistrationStatus.description: Where a registration stands (VTI-EVT-032). `going`: has a place. `maybe`: has said maybe; holds no place. `pending`: awaits a host's decision. `waitlisted`: waits for a place, in order. `withdrawn`: the registrant withdrew. `declined`: a host declined a pending registration. `removed`: a host removed it.
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

ReminderMinutes.description: A reminder's offset: how many minutes before the event's start it is due. At most four weeks.
ReminderMinutes.title: ReminderMinutes

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/withdraw/0.2 request: the member's receipt (VTI-EVT-092). Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/withdraw/0.2#response.

changed.description: False where the registration had already ended — withdrawn, declined or removed — or the event is cancelled, and nothing changed.

event.description: The event as it stood when the community answered.

registration.description: The registration as it now stands — `withdrawn`, or unchanged where it already ended.

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — Withdraw — response payload

RosterSetting.description: Who may see who is registered (VTI-EVT-050). `visible`: registrants who are going or maybe see each other. `hidden`: no registrant sees another; the event's hosts do. Fixed once the event is published (VTI-EVT-051) and recorded on each registration (VTI-EVT-052).
RosterSetting.title: RosterSetting

TimeZoneId.description: An IANA time zone name, such as `Europe/London`, or `Etc/UTC`. A responder MUST refuse a name its time zone database does not know.
TimeZoneId.title: TimeZoneId

When.description: When the event happens, in JSCalendar's terms. `start` is local time in `timeZone`; `duration` is how long it lasts. With `showWithoutTime` true it is an all-day event: `start`'s time MUST be `T00:00:00` and `duration` whole days (VTI-EVT-005).

showWithoutTime.description: An all-day event. Absent means false.

schema.description: A member withdraws their registration for an event: always allowed, never held for anyone's decision, at any time before or after the registration window closes. A place it held passes to the waitlist. The community's signed answer is the member's receipt. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

presentation.description: Only from a party who is not a member of this community, withdrawing the registration they made as a partner's member: their presentation of the membership credential a named partner issued them, as `registrations/register/0.2` takes it (VTI-EVT-132, VTI-EVT-135). Verified before, and without reference to, the event; discarded once decided (VTI-EVT-133). A member never sends it.
